searchText: Hey guys, Can someone point me to why we need `TXCREATE` AND `InitcodeTransaction` from EIP-7620? Been disconnected with EOF and was reading about those and did not understand why cant we just use containers from the EOF callData directly? (a) those two have been cut from the current scope and (b) it's for stuff like 4337 bundling. A UserOperation cannot deploy an EOF contract without some special handling like that. (c) It may return, or we may see COPYCREATE instead, or we may see a precompile/predeploy. Thats a relief thank you for clarifying. And for the super fast response. Respect 🫡 As for creating contracts from calldata, that is a feature we are trying to remove to allow for zero code introspection. This also prevents just in time contract composition, which is difficult for some zk and AOT strategies. When do you expect the spec to update with the removal of those two? is there anything else in the spec that is not up to date? Would love to be as ready as possible for interop. would increase possibility of inclusion in pectra if most clients are ready then https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/78 has the mega spec changes. Then we just need to drag the EIPs along. EIPs have been problematic as I have an EIP I've been trying to get the first commit for from the editors for about a month now. Wait, this keeps TxCreate and InitcodeTransaction Both 78 and 76 are being merged. Net is remove txcrate, initcode transaction, add contract creation mechanism. Sorry frorgot to past the other PR ... https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/76 No worries. thank you Update to the "EXTCALL value cost issue": https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/94#issuecomment-2079490068. Cast your votes.

excerpts.author: smartprogrammer
excerpts.content:
Hey guys,
Can someone point me to why we need `TXCREATE` AND `InitcodeTransaction` from EIP-7620? Been disconnected with EOF and was reading about those and did not understand why cant we just use containers from the EOF callData directly?

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: (a) those two have been cut from the current scope and (b) it's for stuff like 4337 bundling.  A UserOperation cannot deploy an EOF contract without some special handling like that.  (c) It may return, or we may see COPYCREATE instead, or we may see a precompile/predeploy.

excerpts.author: smartprogrammer
excerpts.content: Thats a relief thank you for clarifying.

excerpts.author: smartprogrammer
excerpts.content: And for the super fast response. Respect 🫡

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: As for creating contracts from calldata, that is a feature we are trying to remove to allow for zero code introspection.  This also prevents just in time contract composition, which is difficult for some zk and AOT strategies.

excerpts.author: smartprogrammer
excerpts.content: When do you expect the spec to update with the removal of those two? is there anything else in the spec that is not up to date?

excerpts.author: smartprogrammer
excerpts.content: Would love to be as ready as possible for interop. would increase possibility of inclusion in pectra if most clients are ready then

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/78 has the mega spec changes.  Then we just need to drag the EIPs along.
